title: Psychomotor sexological therapy
blurb: We work with both conversation and body. Psychomotor therapy unites cognition and sensation — a natural path to sexual wellbeing.
body:
## The meeting

You're allowed to be in the room before you have to explain yourself. We begin by arriving and listening to what's present in you — without it having to lead anywhere in particular. 

### When words aren't _enough_

Sometimes we stay with conversation. Other times we work with movement, breath, and self-touch, always based on what you bring into the space and your needs. 

### In your own _order and tempo_

A course of sessions might be about desire, boundaries, relationships, or the body — rarely in a fixed sequence. You don't need to know exactly what you're bringing; we find the direction and phase as we go.

forYou.label: Come by if you —
items: need to learn to say no before you can say yes
are coming out as queer and want to explore what that means for you
are in an open or polyamorous relationship and need a therapist who understands
have had a boundary crossed — recently or long ago
